camel_example: aliyun ndr UpdateBlockingPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --BlockingType ip --BlockingEntity '203.0.113.10' --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies the blocking direction, expiration time, or reason of an existing policy, or enables blocking for an inactive policy
description_zh: 修改已有策略的封禁方向、过期时间或原因；对未生效策略调用时会启用封禁
name: UpdateBlockingPolicy

parameters.help_en: Required. The object type. Valid values: ip and domain. ip indicates an IPv4 address, and domain indicates a domain name
parameters.help_zh: 必填。封禁对象类型，仅支持 ip（IPv4）或 domain（域名）
parameters.name: blocking_type

parameters.help_en: Required. The object to block. If the type is ip, the value must be a single IPv4 address. IPv6 addresses, CIDR blocks, and 0.0.0.0 are not supported. If the type is domain, the value must be a domain name. IP literals and the wildcard character (*) are not supported. The domain name must contain a period (.) and cannot exceed 253 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 必填。封禁对象。ip 类型须为单个 IPv4 地址，不支持 IPv6、CIDR 或 0.0.0.0；domain 类型须为域名，不支持 IP 字面值或通配符 *，须包含点，长度不超过 253 字节
parameters.name: blocking_entity

parameters.help_en:
Required. The direction of the blocking. Valid values: 
in: inbound.
out: outbound.
bidirectional: bidirectional.
If the type is domain, only out is supported
parameters.help_zh: 调用时必填。in 表示入方向，out 表示出方向，bidirectional 表示双向；domain 类型仅支持 out
parameters.name: blocking_direction

parameters.help_en: The updated reason for the blocking. If you omit this parameter, the original reason is cleared. To retain the original reason, you must pass it again
parameters.help_zh: 更新后的封禁原因。省略时清空原有原因；需要保留时请重新传入原值
parameters.name: blocking_reason

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the blocking. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If you omit this parameter or set it to 0, the policy never expires. A non-zero value cannot be earlier than the time when the operation is called. If you omit this parameter, the original expiration time is not retained. To retain the original expiration time, you must pass it again
parameters.help_zh: 封禁过期时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。省略或传 0 表示永不过期；非零值不得早于调用时刻。省略不会保留原过期时间，需要保留时请重新传入原值
parameters.name: blocking_expire_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated security event. This parameter is optional and is not used to locate the blocking policy. Modifying only this parameter does not constitute a valid policy modification, and it is not guaranteed that all newly created tasks carry this association
parameters.help_zh: 关联安全事件 ID，可不传；不用于定位封禁策略。仅修改本字段不构成有效策略修改，也不保证所有新建任务都携带该关联
parameters.name: incident_id

parameters.help_en: The JSON array of blocking products. Default value: CFW. Valid values: cfw and waf
parameters.help_zh: 封禁产品JSON数组，默认CFW；可选cfw、waf
parameters.name: blocking_product

parameters.help_en: The scope of WAF instances selected by the user. A value of true indicates all instances, and a value of false indicates specified instances. The current task is still executed based on the WafInstances list
parameters.help_zh: 记录用户选择的 WAF 实例范围。true 为全部实例，false 为指定实例。当前任务仍按 WafInstances 清单执行
parameters.name: waf_all_instances

fields.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account or member accounts to which the instance belongs
fields.help_zh: 实例所属主账号或成员账号UID
fields.name: member_uid

fields.help_en: The region of the WAF instance
fields.name: region

parameters.help_en: The list of selected WAF instances. This parameter is required if WAF is included. If all instances are selected, you must still submit the complete list
parameters.help_zh: 所选WAF固定实例清单；包含WAF时必传，全部也须提交完整清单
parameters.name: waf_instances

schema.description_en: The processing result of the request

Data.description_en: The business result returned by the operation
Data.description_zh: 本次操作返回的业务结果

TaskItems.description_en: The list of newly added blocking or unblocking tasks. Synchronous update records are not included. If you only modify the expiration time or reason of an active policy, this parameter is empty, which does not indicate a failure
TaskItems.description_zh: 本次新增的封禁或解封任务列表，不包含同步更新记录。已生效策略仅修改过期时间或原因时为空，不表示失败

items.description_en: The information about a newly created asynchronous task
items.description_zh: 一条本次新建的异步任务信息

BlockingDirection.description_en: The direction of the asynchronous task. A value of in indicates inbound, and a value of out indicates outbound. If you change the direction of an active policy from one direction to another, an unblocking task for the old direction and a blocking task for the new direction are created. If you change the direction between unidirectional and bidirectional, tasks are created only for the added or removed directions. If you enable an inactive policy in both directions, an inbound task and an outbound task are created
BlockingDirection.description_zh: 本条异步任务的方向，in 表示入方向，out 表示出方向。已生效策略单向换向会创建旧方向解封和新方向封禁任务；单向与双向之间转换时，只为新增或移除的方向创建任务。未生效策略按双向启用时，分别创建入方向和出方向任务
BlockingDirection.title_en: 云防火墙封禁方向：in入向、out出向、bidirectional双向；WAF执行入向封禁
BlockingDirection.title_zh: 云防火墙封禁方向：in入向、out出向、bidirectional双向；WAF执行入向封禁

BlockingEntity.description_en: The IPv4 address or domain name of the blocked object
BlockingEntity.description_zh: 封禁对象的 IPv4 地址或域名
BlockingEntity.title_en: 封禁实体值，类型为ip时填写IP地址，类型为domain时填写域名
BlockingEntity.title_zh: 封禁实体值，类型为ip时填写IP地址，类型为domain时填写域名

BlockingProduct.description_en: The blocking product. A value of cfw indicates Cloud Firewall, and a value of waf indicates Web Application Firewall
BlockingProduct.description_zh: 封禁产品，cfw表示云防火墙，waf表示Web应用防火墙

items.description_en: The identifier of the blocking product. Valid values: cfw (Cloud Firewall) and waf (Web Application Firewall)
items.description_zh: 封禁产品标识：cfw为云防火墙，waf为Web应用防火墙
items.title_en: 封禁产品标识：cfw为云防火墙，waf为Web应用防火墙
items.title_zh: 封禁产品标识：cfw为云防火墙，waf为Web应用防火墙

BlockingProduct.title_en: 封禁产品，cfw表示云防火墙，waf表示Web应用防火墙
BlockingProduct.title_zh: 封禁产品，cfw表示云防火墙，waf表示Web应用防火墙

BlockingType.description_en: The object type. A value of ip indicates an IPv4 address, and a value of domain indicates a domain name
BlockingType.description_zh: 封禁对象类型。ip 表示 IPv4 地址，domain 表示域名
BlockingType.title_en: 封禁实体类型，ip表示IP地址，domain表示域名
BlockingType.title_zh: 封禁实体类型，ip表示IP地址，domain表示域名

TaskType.description_en: The type of the asynchronous task. A value of 0 indicates manual blocking, and a value of 2 indicates manual unblocking. Records of synchronous configuration modifications are not included
TaskType.description_zh: 本条异步任务的类型。0 表示手动封禁，2 表示手动解封；不包含同步修改配置的记录
TaskType.title_en: 操作类型：0手动封禁、1系统封禁、2手动解封、3系统解封、4编辑、5删除、6批量封禁、7应急暂停、8应急恢复
TaskType.title_zh: 操作类型：0手动封禁、1系统封禁、2手动解封、3系统解封、4编辑、5删除、6批量封禁、7应急暂停、8应急恢复

TaskUuid.description_en: The UUID of the newly created task. You can pass this UUID to the TaskUuids parameter of DescribeBlockingTaskStatus to query the execution result
TaskUuid.description_zh: 本条新建任务的 UUID，可传入 DescribeBlockingTaskStatus 的 TaskUuids 查询执行结果
TaskUuid.title_en: 封禁任务唯一标识，用于查询执行状态和操作详情
TaskUuid.title_zh: 封禁任务唯一标识，用于查询执行状态和操作详情

TaskItems.title_en: 已受理任务；实际执行结果需查询任务状态
TaskItems.title_zh: 已受理任务；实际执行结果需查询任务状态

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. If the request is successful, an empty string is returned. For example, InvalidParam indicates that the request parameters are invalid, which is not an error code for a successful response
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；成功时为空字符串。示例 InvalidParam 表示请求参数无效，不代表成功响应的错误码

Message.description_en: The result description of the request. The value is success if the request is successful, or an error message if the request fails
Message.description_zh: 本次请求的结果说明；成功时为 success，失败时返回错误说明

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to troubleshoot and locate the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查和定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call is successful. A value of true indicates that the request is processed successfully, and a value of false indicates that the request fails. For an asynchronous API, a success response does not mean that the task is completed
Success.description_zh: 本次接口调用是否成功。true 表示请求处理成功，false 表示失败；异步接口的成功不表示任务已经执行完成
